purpose: Place the exact original frozen release ZIP into governed GitHub-side binary custody, without re-compression or reconstruction.

package.verificationMethod: sha256 plus byte-level cmp against the exact bytes R0.2 read
package.note: The archive is the original build artifact. Its internal entry timestamps match the 2026-09-02 release identity; no entry was rewritten.

provenance.howObtained: Uploaded into this session by the project owner as the recovered frozen release package. R0.2 read these exact bytes when it verified the package hash and extracted the 30 validated files; no other copy was used.
provenance.driveNote: The Drive file id is carried from historical P6.0/P3O evidence. This stage did not download from Drive; identity rests on the canonical SHA-256, not on filename or location.

filenameVariantsObserved.context: name used in independent QA instruction

identitySelectionRule: Identity is established solely by the canonical SHA-256 b81b22d2..., never by filename or date. All observed filename variants that were hashed resolve to the same bytes.

historicalHashEvidence.treatment: Retained as historical evidence per independent QA. Not deleted, not rewritten, and not used to establish current identity. The current acceptance identity is b81b22d2...
historicalHashEvidence.note: Recorded here for lineage completeness; this reference does not appear in the R0.2 branch content.

registerTreatment.recommendedGovernedAction: After QA verifies these bytes, update repositoryBinaryMaterialization and bind the custodied repository path, preserving the existing fileName and sha256 lineage.

githubArtifactCustody.mechanism: actions/upload-artifact publishes the exact committed binary; the workflow re-verifies its SHA-256 before upload and fails closed on mismatch.
githubArtifactCustody.retrievableBy: independent QA from the R0.2 workflow run
